title: Destructive SQL Guard
description: Intercept DROP / TRUNCATE / DELETE-without-WHERE before an agent executes it.
implementation:
Matches the SQL string passed to a database/MCP tool. Destructive statements
are denied by default; a DELETE/UPDATE without a WHERE clause is always denied.
Statements on a non-production target can be allowed with a `--allow-destructive`
flag that requires a human confirmation token.
